description: Newest liquidity pools created on Base (Uniswap v3/v4, Aerodrome) with a bytecode risk score per new token (PAID, 0.001 USDC). Filters are optional.

maxRisk.description: Only pools whose risk score is at most this

minRisk.description: Only pools whose risk score is at least this

since.description: ISO-8601 timestamp; only pools detected after it
